info.title: QuickStore API
info.description: Quick-commerce operating platform: warehouses, dark stores, inventory ledger, procurement, orders, fulfilment, delivery.

quantityDelta.description: Positive adds stock, negative removes it

skuIds.description: Restrict to these SKUs (cycle count). Omit for a full count.

unitCost.description: Defaults to the latest supplier price
Invoiced unit cost; differences from the PO are flagged

fromCart.description: Use the open cart when items are omitted

idempotencyKey.description: Client-generated key; retries with the same key return the same order

shortPicks.description: Lines picked short; other lines use their scanned quantity

userId.description: Link to an employee login with the DELIVERY_PARTNER role

riderId.description: Omit to auto-select the least-loaded available rider of the store

latitude.description: Only send a real device GPS fix

clientOpId.description: Globally unique id generated on the device (UUID)

performedBy.description: Employee who performed the action on the device
